```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next" \
     -H "x-apikey: pp_key123"
```

### Example using Python (`requests`)

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "pp_key123",
}
params = {
    "limit": 25,
    "cursor": "pp_next",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Replace `pp_key123` with your actual API key. The `cursor` parameter (`pp_next` in your example) is used for pagination; VirusTotal will return a `next_cursor` value in the response if more results are available.

If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to ask!
